items.title: Annie Ross — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Elton John was born there. That’s where I was born, in a house.

ctx.x: Annie, if I could, just to come back and fill in a few details and make sure the historical record is accurate, it’s listed as – Mitcham, England, is listed as your birthplace. That must be in Surrey. So if you could explain.
It’s – Surrey is a little town. Elton John was born there. That’s where I was born, in a house. It’s outside of London. That’s about it.
